newsitem.title: USA: Six U.S. cooperatives buy Ohio pet food business.
newsitem.headline: Six U.S. cooperatives buy Ohio pet food business.

text.p: Six U.S. agricultural cooperatives purchased pet food manufacturer Pro-Pet L.L.C. on Thursday, Growmark Inc said.

In a statement released Friday, Growmark said it and Countrymark Cooperative, Land O' Lakes, Tennessee Farmers Cooperative, Southern States Cooperative and Agway Inc tookake over the pet food company October 31.

Pro-Pet, based in St. Mary's, Ohio, produced 50,000 tons of pet and companion animal foods in 1995. The facility was previously owned by Agway Inc, which will retain a one-sixth interest, Growmark said.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
